addons.editions.heading: Choose your platform
addons.editions.description: This add-on has separate macOS and Windows editions. Each page documents the features, settings, requirements, and screenshots for that platform.
addons.editions.descriptionSingle: This add-on is currently available for {platform} only. Its edition page documents the features, settings, requirements, and screenshots.
addons.editions.guide.heading: Guide for this edition
addons.editions.guide.description: Set up the add-on and verify its platform-specific capabilities with a first practical workflow.
addons.editions.guide.install: In TypeWhisper, open Settings > Discover plugins and install {name}. The add-on then appears in the Settings sidebar, and its page opens. If it is already installed, open its page in the sidebar.
addons.editions.guide.installListedAs: In TypeWhisper, open Settings > Discover plugins and install {name}, which is listed there as {appName}. The add-on then appears in the Settings sidebar, and its page opens. If it is already installed, open its page in the sidebar.
addons.editions.guide.openSettings: On the add-on's page, review the options available in this edition.
addons.editions.guide.activate.transcrip: Under Settings > Dictation, select {name} as the Provider and choose a Model. A Dictation Only workflow can also use its own transcription model.
addons.editions.guide.activate.llm: In a workflow, select {name} as the Provider under Advanced, or choose it as the Default LLM for workflows without a provider of their own.
addons.editions.guide.activate.tts: Under Settings > Advanced > Spoken feedback, turn on Spoken feedback and choose a voice from {name} under Voice.
addons.editions.guide.activate.action: Create or open a workflow and choose {name} as its action target.
addons.editions.guide.activate.postProce: Enable the add-on and test its configuration before using it in the post-processing pipeline for dictations.
addons.editions.guide.activate.memory: Enable memory in TypeWhisper and configure an LLM for extracting facts. Enable only the storage add-ons you intend to use; macOS stores extracted memories in all ready memory providers. A cloud LLM receives the text used for extraction even when storage is local.
addons.editions.guide.activate.utility: Enable the integration and run a short test to verify its output, window, or event handling.
addons.editions.guide.example.transcript: Dictate a few sentences with {name} and check the language, model, and result before you use it for longer recordings.
addons.editions.guide.example.llm: Create a meeting-notes workflow, select {name} as its LLM provider, and turn a short dictation into a summary, decisions, and action items.
addons.editions.guide.example.tts: Enable spoken feedback, select {name} as the voice provider, and test a short sentence before adjusting speed or quality.
addons.editions.guide.example.action: Create a workflow with {name} as its action target and dictate a short, clearly structured test. Then inspect the object created at the destination.
addons.editions.guide.example.postProces: Process a test dictation that visibly changes capitalization, punctuation, or a fixed output format, and inspect the result before regular use.
addons.editions.guide.example.memory: Let a workflow store one distinctive test fact, then use a later prompt that retrieves that fact.
addons.editions.guide.example.utility: Start a short recording or matching workflow and immediately inspect the visible output or triggered event.
addons.editions.guide.example.webhook: Send a short test dictation to a dedicated test endpoint, then check the payload there and the delivery status under Recent deliveries before using the webhook in production.
addons.editions.guide.localProcessing: This add-on performs its own storage or processing locally. Model and runtime downloads may need an internet connection. Other steps, such as transcription, memory extraction or workflow prompts, use their separately configured providers.
addons.editions.guide.cloudProcessing: This edition uses a cloud provider. Depending on the capability, audio, text, or both are sent only after you configure and select that provider.
addons.iosEmpty: No separate iOS add-ons are listed here yet. The iOS guide covers its built-in engines and providers.
addons.editions.guide.customProcessing: Whether content stays local depends on the configured server, script, or destination. Remote services receive the data passed to them.
addons.editions.newerHost.title: Newer app version required
addons.editions.newerHost.description: This plugin version requires TypeWhisper {minimum}. The current stable edition for this platform is {stable} and does not yet meet that requirement.
addons.editions.guide.activate.windowsMe: To reuse saved facts, open a workflow that processes text with an LLM and choose {name} under Memory context. Up to five matching entries are sent to that workflow's LLM provider. TypeWhisper for Windows does not extract memories automatically, and Dictation Only workflows do not use memory context.
addons.editions.guide.example.windowsMem: Save a distinctive test fact such as “Project Aurora uses British English.”, choose {name} under Memory context in a text-processing workflow, and ask that workflow which spelling Aurora uses. Then set Memory context to Off and check that the answer no longer uses the fact.
